title: Marketing Automation & CRM
description: Design automated customer nurturing sequences and routing paths. Tests lead scoring, CRM triggers, and automated workflows.

seo.overviewBody: Marketing automation nurture leads automatically at scale. Hiring managers test candidates on designing CRM workflows (HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo), establishing demographic and behavioral lead scoring models, and automating pipeline stage updates.

deliverables.title: 1. CRM Workflow Architecture & Nurture Spec
deliverables.desc: Blueprint detailing trigger conditions, conditional branching, delay timers, and automated internal task creation.

deliverables.title: 2. Automated Lead Scoring Model Configuration
deliverables.desc: Lead scoring matrix assigning point values for demographic fit and behavioral actions (email clicks, pricing page visits).

deliverables.title: 3. CRM Data Hygiene & Segmentation Audit
deliverables.desc: Audit report identifying un-engaged contacts, duplicate lead entries, and list cleanup rules.

faqs.question: What is the difference between demographic and behavioral lead scoring?
faqs.answer: Demographic scoring awards points for job title or company size. Behavioral scoring awards points for active engagements like downloading a whitepaper or visiting the pricing page.

faqs.question: When should a lead be handed off from Marketing (MQL) to Sales (SQL)?
faqs.answer: A Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL) becomes a Sales Qualified Lead (SQL) when their cumulative lead score crosses an agreed threshold or when they request a live demo/quote.

faqs.question: How do automated workflow delay steps improve deliverability?
faqs.answer: Inserting realistic delays (e.g. 2 days between emails) prevents subscribers from feeling spammed and reduces unsubscribe rates.
